details: Contribution is sales less standard-cost usage and loaded hourly labor.
Incomplete inventory cannot produce an apparently complete contribution.
Missing counts or negative usage suppress location food cost and contribution.
Invoice lines require investigation against physical receipt and vendor mapping.
Net sales must exclude tax and tips and subtract posted refunds.
Repeated check-level tips and business date must agree across all accepted order lines.
Order/date expected collections differ from reported tender movements; not bank settlement.
Refund tender must match an independently recorded refund.
Cumulative refunded tips cannot exceed the check tip.
Cumulative financial refunds cannot exceed original net sale or tax.
Rejected records remain in bronze and quarantine; review before operational use.
Nonzero physical usage after recipe consumption and recorded waste; investigate, do not silently adjust.
